title: Wave 4 — Civic Intelligence
objective: Turn BetterMakati's existing records, place infrastructure and participation systems into a connected civic-intelligence layer that helps people understand Makati through sourced statistics, legislation, integrity records and high-quality reports.

executionDoctrine.cadence: One user 'Next' executes exactly one micro-step.
scopeCap: Research, implementation and whole-site QA do not happen in the same micro-step.
If a step expands unexpectedly, split it before continuing.
One focused verification pass, then stop.
executionDoctrine.deployment: Do not manually deploy after every micro-step while build-rate pressure remains. Commit cleanly and report CI/deployment evidence separately.

productDoctrine: No sermons. Pages should do the job rather than explain why BetterMakati exists.
No completeness bragging, methodology speeches, guardrail repetition or self-congratulation in normal page copy. Put necessary methodology where it belongs and let the feature speak for itself.
Start from the citizen's question or task, then show the evidence.
Use green as the dominant BetterMakati visual field and gold selectively for identity/emphasis; preserve the existing warm-white reading surfaces and restrained typography.
Prefer strong opening statements, clear headlines, compact summaries, charts/tables and direct record links over explanatory walls of text.
One report equals one synthesis. A bundle of unrelated observations is not one report.
Featured report cards show headline, subheadline, date and Read more. One report per card. Do not use 'Makati Overview' as a catch-all label.
Inline citations belong beside factual claims. Source lists support the article but do not replace inline evidence.
Distinguish fact, calculation, inference and uncertainty. Never fill source gaps by inference.
Use official Makati sources first for Makati-specific records, then authoritative national sources, then credible secondary sources where necessary.
Preserve current-boundary comparability. Never mix historical 33-barangay Makati and current 23-barangay Makati without an explicit geographic treatment.

Canonical assets are shared infrastructure. Statistics, legislation, integrity records and reports should link to Place Registry entities when the source explicitly identifies a place; never fuzzy-link by proximity, barangay or similar names.
Reuse canonical barangays, officials, services, projects, Accountability records, City Monitor records and public records instead of creating parallel copies.
Relationships must be explicit and typed. Cross-linking is not a reason to duplicate data.
A page-specific data object should own only information unique to that page; shared facts should live in canonical datasets.
Search should surface the same canonical entity rather than a duplicate search-only record.
Barangay slicing applies only where the underlying record has canonical barangay scope. Never infer local attribution from free text alone.
No generic scores, star ratings, popularity rankings or invented composite indexes unless the underlying methodology and denominator genuinely justify them.
Integrity pages are evidence indexes, not accusation engines. Do not label a person, supplier or entity corrupt, suspicious or risky from association, concentration or missing data.

Political and legislative information stays descriptive and sourced: records, actions, dates, text, sponsors/authors when officially documented, and lifecycle evidence. Do not rank officials or legislation.
Missing public records are source gaps, not evidence of wrongdoing.
Procurement award, contract, implementation, payment, audit finding and resolution are separate stages and must not be collapsed.
Reports & Insights should synthesize information already supported elsewhere in BetterMakati whenever possible, linking internally to the underlying city record before sending users outward.

Cross-functional links should be useful in both directions where the relationship is stable: place ↔ record, legislation ↔ service/topic/place, integrity entity ↔ procurement/project, report ↔ underlying records.
Avoid loops: every related-link module should take the user somewhere meaningfully deeper, not back to a page with no additional context.
Mobile, keyboard, touch-target, focus and reduced-motion requirements from Wave 3 remain baseline requirements, not a final cleanup task.

Treat BetterMakati as Makati’s local layer in the wider BetterGov ecosystem: link outward to BetterGov for national datasets/tools and to BetterLGU or sibling local sites for non-Makati/local-comparison context when a useful canonical destination exists. Prefer handoff/context over duplicating another product’s data.
preservedFoundations: Wave 3 Place Registry and typed place/segment/route model.
Accountability Ledger, Projects & Budget, City Monitor and Public Records.
Wave 3 case lifecycle, structured observations and civic audits.
Existing Featured Reports article model as content to migrate, not a constraint on the Wave 4 schema.
Existing Statistics, Legislation and Integrity pages as starting implementations to audit rather than discard blindly.
explicitNonGoals: Do not build a generic AI-generated report factory.
Do not scrape and publish every ordinance, statistic or supplier merely to maximize count.
Do not create political rankings, official performance scores, corruption risk scores or contractor blacklists.
Do not replace official legislation or audit records with BetterMakati summaries.
Do not make the Reports section a repository of snippets.
Do not reopen completed Wave 3 Place Registry source reconciliation unless a Wave 4 relationship exposes a specific error.
Do not combine unresolved Wave 3 participation-report redesign with unrelated Wave 4 statistics work before the Reports phase.

workstreams.stopWhen: Sequence, micro-steps, accumulated product doctrine, cross-function rules and explicit non-goals are frozen.

canonicalFindings: 23 barangay profiles sum exactly to the current 2024 city population of 309,770.
2024 city population is duplicated across Statistics, budget2025 and report prose.
Population trend is page-local data and should migrate to the indicator layer.
GDP per person is numerically owned by cityComparison.ts but repeated as formatted page text.
Budget/fiscal series already have a canonical owner in budget2025.ts and should be reused rather than copied.

Opening remains generic and contains one meta/sermon sentence slated for W4-1g.

Place Registry counts must not be used as citywide infrastructure statistics without an independently source-backed denominator.

workstreams.title: Audit Makati legislation sources and current page
workstreams.maximumScope: Source and product audit only: official Makati archive, City Monitor legislative records, Public Records and current external-search fallback.
workstreams.stopWhen: Available record fields, archive limitations and duplicate sources are documented.

validation.officialArchive: Current Makati archive supports keyword/document-code search and All/Resolution/Ordinance filtering; official documents can expose measure number, title, authors where stated, enactment/session date, signatories, approval and full text.
validation.currentSessions: The official Makati Web Portal currently surfaces regular council-session videos through September 2026; session-video availability is therefore not itself a current source gap.
validation.facebook: The City Government's 2020 Annual Report confirms MyMakati Facebook as an official council-session streaming channel; current direct Facebook fetch was unavailable in the audit environment, so specific session links still require preserved official URLs.
validation.certifiedCopies: The Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod remains the official fallback for certified copies/photocopies of ordinances and resolutions.
validation.currentProduct: BetterMakati currently has no canonical local ordinance/resolution registry; Legislation uses Google site search, Public Records indexes the archive rather than individual measures, and City Monitor does not normalize current session videos/measures.
validation.keyCorrection: CityMonitor's council-session source-gap wording is now too pessimistic. The remaining gaps are normalization, completeness checking, agendas/minutes/votes, and explicit measure-to-session lifecycle links.
validation.evidenceRule: A session video is session evidence, not proof by itself of passage, vote tally, mayoral action, effectiveness, authorship or amendment/repeal status.

workstreams.title: Define local legislation registry schema
workstreams.maximumScope: Schema only for ordinances/resolutions plus typed council-session evidence: identifier, number, title, type, dates, official text, authors when stated, lifecycle events, session video/agenda/minutes relationships, civic relationships and provenance.
workstreams.stopWhen: Schema supports canonical local measures, reusable official session evidence and City Monitor links without inventing enactment, vote or mayoral-action status.

validation.canonicalMeasure: One record represents one Makati ordinance or resolution with stable ID, official number/reference, title, jurisdiction, official documents, provenance and revision metadata.
lifecycleModel: No single guessed currentStatus/status field exists.
Lifecycle is an array of evidence-backed events such as filing/referral/readings/council approval/mayoral action/effectiveness/amendment/repeal.
Every lifecycle event carries evidenceStatus and sourceIds; missing events remain unknown.
sessionEvidence: Session links support regular/special sessions, committee/public hearings and reuse a canonical City Monitor record when available.
Measure/session relationships distinguish mentioned, calendared, referred, deliberated, read, voted, approved and enacted actions.
Reviewed official video is an allowed evidence class, but video existence alone is not treated as proof of measure action.
legalRelationships: Measure-to-measure links cover amends/amended-by, repeals/repealed-by, implements/implemented-by, supersedes/superseded-by and cites.
Mayoral approval/veto/effectiveness/authorship require explicit official evidence.
crossFunctionality: Typed civic targets cover barangay, service, place/segment/route, project, Accountability, City Monitor, Public Records, report, indicator and Integrity records.
National law/bill and ecosystem-resource targets support BetterGov/Open Congress/Lawphil-style context without replacing the official Makati measure.
validation.recordAccess: Schema supports Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod certified-copy/photocopy fallback when public text is unavailable or legal certification is needed.
validation.assetGuard: Place/segment/route relationships require canonical IDs and explicit source evidence; fuzzy/proximity linking is prohibited.
validation.focusedValidation: All 13 schema requirements exposed by W4-2a are represented; JSON parses; ordinance/resolution types, lifecycle/session evidence, measure relationships, certified-copy fallback and BetterGov ecosystem targets are present; no top-level guessed status field exists.
validation.implementationBoundary: Schema only. No ordinance/resolution records, session normalization or page changes were implemented in W4-2b.

workstreams.title: Implement verified integrity relationships
workstreams.maximumScope: Only W4-3c/3d/3e verified relationships. No new research.
workstreams.stopWhen: Integrity entity graph links procurement/audit/accountability records with provenance and no broken targets.

workstreams.title: Redesign Integrity page around evidence
workstreams.maximumScope: Integrity page only. Replace standards-and-gaps sermon structure with searchable evidence, entities, audit trails and direct source links.
workstreams.stopWhen: The page surfaces what is documented, what is unresolved and where to inspect the record without labeling people/entities.

workstreams.title: Audit existing Featured Reports
workstreams.maximumScope: Content audit only of current reports, homepage/Reports presentation and underlying source links.
workstreams.stopWhen: Each existing report is classified keep, rewrite, merge into another synthesis or retire; no new report is written.

workstreams.title: Define report schema v2
workstreams.maximumScope: Schema only: one synthesis, headline, subheadline, date, paragraphs/sections, inline evidence, charts/tables, related canonical records, methodology note only when necessary.
workstreams.stopWhen: The schema supports a news/article reading experience and typed links to statistics, legislation, integrity, place, project and accountability records.

workstreams.title: Migrate existing reports to report schema v2
workstreams.maximumScope: Existing reports only. No new research except resolving broken citations.
workstreams.stopWhen: Retained reports use one-synthesis structure, inline evidence and canonical internal sources.

workstreams.title: Publish one Statistics-derived flagship report
workstreams.maximumScope: Exactly one high-quality synthesis using the Wave 4 Statistics layer. No report batch.
workstreams.stopWhen: The report makes one defensible claim, cites every factual basis and links back to underlying indicators.

workstreams.title: Publish one records-derived flagship report
workstreams.maximumScope: Exactly one high-quality synthesis from legislation/integrity/accountability records where the evidence supports a meaningful story.
workstreams.stopWhen: The report has one synthesis and distinguishes source facts from BetterMakati analysis.

workstreams.title: Redesign Reports & Insights landing
workstreams.maximumScope: Reports landing only. One report per card; headline, subheadline, date, Read more; strong carousel/list hierarchy and no overview/meta copy.
workstreams.stopWhen: The page reads like a high-quality publication index rather than a repository.

workstreams.title: Reuse Featured Reports on the homepage
workstreams.maximumScope: Homepage featured-report module only, reusing the same canonical report data/component.
workstreams.stopWhen: Homepage and /reports cannot drift because both render the same report objects.

workstreams.title: Resolve Wave 3 Civic Reports partial capability
workstreams.maximumScope: /civic-map/reports only. Replace volume/popularity-led emphasis with threshold-gated case outcomes, observation freshness and audit coverage where publication rules allow.
workstreams.stopWhen: The known W3R-CAP-12 gap is either closed by implementation or remains explicitly deferred because thresholds are not met.

workstreams.title: Define shared civic-intelligence relationship model
workstreams.maximumScope: Relationship schema/helper only. Typed references across indicator, legislation, integrity entity, report, place, barangay, service, project/accountability, City Monitor, public record and BetterGov/BetterLGU ecosystem resources.
workstreams.stopWhen: Relationships can be stored once and resolved without circular data duplication.

workstreams.title: Connect Statistics to canonical city entities
workstreams.maximumScope: Explicit relationships from implemented indicators to barangays, services, places/assets, budget/project records, reports and relevant BetterGov/BetterLGU comparison or national-data resources where semantically valid.
workstreams.stopWhen: A small verified set demonstrates reusable bidirectional navigation without inferred place attribution.

workstreams.title: Connect Legislation across the site
workstreams.maximumScope: Legislation relationships/backlinks only: services, barangays, places/assets, City Monitor, Public Records, Accountability and relevant BetterGov national-law/context resources.
workstreams.stopWhen: Users can move from a law/council record to the relevant civic entity and back without duplicate copies.

workstreams.title: Connect Integrity evidence across the site
workstreams.maximumScope: Integrity relationships/backlinks only: procurement, projects, Accountability, audit findings, places when source-specific, Public Records and relevant BetterGov procurement/budget/benchmark resources.
workstreams.stopWhen: Supplier/audit/entity evidence is reachable from the underlying record and vice versa.

workstreams.title: Connect Reports to their underlying records
workstreams.maximumScope: Report-related-record modules and backlinks only, including relevant BetterGov/BetterLGU continuation links when they deepen the report’s evidence or comparison context.
workstreams.stopWhen: Every report exposes the canonical data/record set it synthesizes, and applicable records can surface the report as analysis rather than source evidence.

workstreams.title: Extend global Search to Civic Intelligence
workstreams.maximumScope: Search indexing only for canonical indicators, legislation, integrity entities and reports; include deliberate ecosystem handoffs without cloning BetterGov/BetterLGU records into BetterMakati search.
workstreams.stopWhen: Search returns one canonical destination per entity and avoids duplicate title-only records.

workstreams.title: Integrate Public Records and documents
workstreams.maximumScope: Public Records/document viewer integration only for new Wave 4 source types.
workstreams.stopWhen: Primary documents are reachable from the record pages and record pages are reachable from document entries where identity is explicit.

workstreams.title: Run anti-sermon and design consistency pass
workstreams.maximumScope: Wave 4 surfaces only. Remove explanatory/meta copy, duplicate methodology, bragging and inconsistent visual patterns; do not add new functionality.
workstreams.stopWhen: Statistics, Legislation, Integrity and Reports share the BetterMakati visual language and let the records/features speak for themselves.

workstreams.title: Run Civic Intelligence human/relationship audit
workstreams.maximumScope: Wave 4 surfaces and cross-links only. Check source integrity, broken relationships, mobile/accessibility baseline and user journeys.
workstreams.stopWhen: Every Wave 4 surface has an evidence-based status and every canonical relationship resolves.

workstreams.title: Reclassify and close Wave 4
workstreams.maximumScope: Classification/closure only. Record complete, bounded, partial and deferred capabilities without inflating completion.
workstreams.stopWhen: Wave 4 is closed only to the extent supported by evidence, with future work reopened as specific capabilities rather than vague unfinished work.

immediateNext.title: Normalize full official ordinance/resolution archive
immediateNext.maximumScope: Official Makati resolutions-and-ordinances archive only. Enumerate every retrievable archive entry in a dated snapshot, normalize ordinance/resolution identity, reference, title and official document/source URLs, and reconcile duplicates against the existing 20-record seed. No topic tagging or lifecycle inference in the same step.

inheritedKnownItems.note: Do not treat the Wave 3 public feedback-loop presentation gap as closed until W4-4h is executed.
Wave 4 may link only to existing canonical records. Any specific registry error discovered through a relationship gets a bounded correction.

scope: BetterGov national data, visualizations, budget, procurement/price and other relevant civic resources.
BetterLGU for cross-LGU or non-Makati local-government context.
Sibling Better* local sites only when a canonical resource exists and materially deepens the Makati record.
rules: BetterMakati remains the canonical Makati layer; do not duplicate a BetterGov/BetterLGU dataset merely to make an outbound link look local.
Primary official sources remain visible beside ecosystem handoffs.
Use typed ecosystem relationships once W4-5a defines the shared relationship model.
Prefer contextual handoffs such as compare nationally, compare with another LGU, inspect national source/benchmark, or continue to a broader tool.
Do not create circular links that return users to equivalent pages without additional information.
